claim: Retrieval-augmented generation reduces factual errors of language models on knowledge-intensive tasks.
claim_zh: 检索增强生成能减少语言模型在知识密集型任务上的事实错误。
evidence: We combine a pre-trained retriever with a sequence-to-sequence generator and find that retrieval-augmented models generate more factual and specific language than a parametric-only baseline on knowledge-intensive tasks.

claim: Dense passage retrieval outperforms BM25 on open-domain question answering.
claim_zh: 在开放域问答上，稠密段落检索优于 BM25。
evidence: Our dense retriever outperforms a strong Lucene-BM25 system by 9%-19% absolute in terms of top-20 passage retrieval accuracy on open-domain question answering benchmarks.

claim: Residual connections make very deep convolutional networks easier to train.
claim_zh: 残差连接让很深的卷积网络更容易训练。
evidence: We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously, and show these residual networks are easier to optimize.

claim: Rice blast causes no measurable yield loss in humid regions.
claim_zh: 稻瘟病在湿润地区不会造成可测的产量损失。
evidence: Rice blast is one of the most destructive diseases of rice, and epidemics in humid regions can cause yield losses of 10% to 30%.

claim: Federated learning requires participants to upload their raw training data.
claim_zh: 联邦学习要求参与方上传原始训练数据。
evidence: Federated learning enables multiple clients to collaboratively train a shared model while keeping their training data on device, exchanging only model updates.

claim: Transformers rely entirely on attention mechanisms without recurrence.
claim_zh: Transformer 完全依赖注意力机制，不使用循环结构。
evidence: We propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
